project: VIYLSA — 360° virtual tours with a built-in AI guide (viylsa.app)
purpose: Generation brief for a full custom icon + graphic set to replace the current off-the-shelf Lucide-style icon subset in src/icons.jsx and the placeholder brand/social images in public/assets. Every entry below is a single AI image generation job: PNG, transparent background, one subject per image.
how_to_use: Generate one image per entry in `assets` × one image per entry in that asset's `color_variants`.
Always generate at `generate_at_px` (square, or the stated aspect for wide graphics), then downscale to each size in `export_px`. Never upscale.
Feed the model: brand.global_prompt_prefix + the asset's `prompt`. Feed brand.global_negative_prompt + the asset's `negative_prompt` as the negative.
Save masters to assets-src/icons/<id>--<variant>.png, ship downscales to public/assets/icons/<id>-<variant>@<n>x.png.
Check every export against brand.acceptance_checklist before it goes in the repo.
important_engineering_notes: The site currently renders these as inline SVG (src/icons.jsx) with stroke=currentColor. That is why one icon serves crimson, white and pink contexts, and why the contact tiles can recolour pink→white on hover with zero extra files. Moving to PNG loses that: every colour context becomes its own file, and hover states need a second file swapped in CSS. Each asset below therefore lists explicit `color_variants` — generate all of them.

PNG at 13–18px display is the risk area: raster edges soften where the SVG was pixel-crisp. Exporting @3x and letting the browser downscale (as specced here) is the mitigation. If any small glyph looks muddy after export, the honest fallback is to keep that one as SVG.
apple-touch-icon must NOT be transparent — iOS composites it onto a black or white plate and a transparent mark disappears. That entry ships opaque on purpose.
og-image is a 1200×630 opaque JPEG, not a transparent PNG. It is included because it is part of the same visual system.
public/404.html is deliberately self-contained (system fonts, inline CSS, no build-hashed assets) so it can never break. No graphic is specced for it on purpose.

brand.positioning: Editorial, restrained, premium. Reads like a design-led studio, not a SaaS template. Warm paper surfaces, deep wine-crimson, generous whitespace, real typographic craft. Nothing bubbly, nothing neon, nothing cartoon.

crimson.role: PRIMARY. Icons on light surfaces, brand mark, accent rules. Matches the live tour player.

crimson_soft.role: Tinted badge surfaces behind crimson icons

crimson_bright.role: Sparing accent only — notification dots, hot hotspots. Never a whole icon.

pink_on_dark.role: Icon colour on the dark contact/hero bands — a desaturated crimson tint that survives on near-black

white.role: Icons on crimson fills and on the dark 'how it works' band

success_green.role: The single non-brand colour in the system — lead-captured confirmation ticks only

typography.display_and_wordmark: Playfair Display — high-contrast transitional serif, tall ascenders, sharp bracketed serifs
typography.note: No text of any kind belongs inside a generated icon. Typography is listed only so the artwork's weight and contrast sit next to it comfortably: aim for a stroke that feels as considered as a Playfair hairline, never chunky.

geometry.icon_grid: 24 × 24 units, the same grid the current icons use, so replacements drop in without re-spacing anything
geometry.stroke_weight: 1.75 of 24 units = 7.3% of canvas width. On a 1024×1024 canvas that is a 75px stroke. Uniform — the same weight on every path in every icon in the set.
geometry.terminals: Fully rounded caps and rounded joins. No square, no mitred, no tapered ends.
geometry.live_area: Artwork occupies the centred 83% of the canvas (20 of 24 units). Roughly 8.5% clear transparent margin on all four sides.
geometry.corner_radii_in_system: 4 / 6 / 10 / 16 / 24px — where an icon contains a rounded rectangle, keep its corners soft but not pill-shaped
geometry.fill_rule: Outline only. No filled shapes, with one deliberate exception: a play triangle and small indicator dots are solid.
geometry.perspective: Flat, straight-on, orthographic. No isometric, no 3D, no drop shadow — except the brand mark, which keeps its existing constructed-perspective geometry.

brand.style_dna: The existing brand mark is the anchor: an angular crimson monogram built from straight mitred strokes — an open cube seen from the front-above, a solid dot at its centre, spokes radiating out. It reads simultaneously as a 'V', a viewpoint, and a 360° camera node. The icon set should feel like it was drawn by the same hand: confident single-weight geometry, generous internal spacing, no decorative flourish, every shape resolvable at 16px.
brand.global_prompt_prefix: A single minimal geometric line icon, flat 2D vector style, centred on a fully transparent background. Drawn on a 24-unit grid with one uniform stroke weight of 7.3% of the canvas width (approximately 75px on a 1024×1024 canvas), fully rounded stroke caps and rounded joins, outline only, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, no container shape, no frame. Artwork fills the centred 83% of the canvas with even transparent margin on all four sides. Precise, editorial, premium — in the spirit of Lucide or Feather icons but drawn with wider internal spacing and more confidence. One subject only, one icon per image, no variations, no grid sheet.
brand.global_negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, typography, watermark, signature, logo, background colour, white background, checkerboard background, container box, rounded-rectangle badge behind icon, frame, border, drop shadow, glow, gradient, gradient mesh, 3D, bevel, emboss, skeuomorphic, photorealistic, glossy highlight, glass effect, neon, multiple colours, colour fringing, varying stroke widths, tapered strokes, square caps, hand-drawn wobble, sketchy lines, clutter, extra decorative details, multiple icons, icon sheet, grid of variations, cropped edges, off-centre composition, cartoon, emoji style, mascot, drop-shadowed duplicate, jpeg artefacts
acceptance_checklist: Background is genuinely transparent — no white plate, no near-white halo around strokes
Stroke weight is visually identical to every other icon in the set when placed side by side at the same size
All terminals are round; no stray square cap
Subject is optically centred (not just mathematically centred) with even breathing room
Exactly one colour, and it matches the variant hex exactly
No text, no numbers, no signature anywhere in the frame
Edges are clean at 100% — no colour fringing from a coloured background the model quietly assumed

delivery_rules.export_rule: Downscale only, Lanczos. Ship @2x and @3x for anything displayed under 24px; ship @1x/@2x for anything larger.
delivery_rules.optimise_with: npx oxipng -o4 --strip safe  (or squoosh oxipng) before committing
